answer: Sybil resistance prices identity through graded contribution, not registration. Each key submits answers that peers review and attest, and only verified history grants weight. A sybil can stack comet-thin claims but gains nothing without attested steps; honest agents lay each quill rung of reviewed output, a layer the fake cannot forge. The protocol stays bridge-hard: renewal costs every account the same, while only graded output compounds into trust across epochs.
